setup.command:
set -euo pipefail
if ! command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    exit 3
fi
head_commit=$(git rev-parse --verify 'HEAD^{commit}')
worktree_hash=$(
    git diff --binary --full-index --no-ext-diff --no-textconv HEAD -- |
        git hash-object --stdin
)
status_hash=$(
    git status --porcelain=v1 -z --untracked-files=all |
        git hash-object --stdin
)
index_hash=$(
    git ls-files --stage -z |
        git hash-object --stdin
)
printf 'head_commit	%s
' "$head_commit"
printf 'worktree_hash	%s
' "$worktree_hash"
printf 'status_hash	%s
' "$status_hash"
printf 'index_hash	%s
' "$index_hash"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import sys
from PyQt5.QtCore import QTimer
from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QApplication
from qutebrowser.qt.network import QNetworkRequest, QNetworkReply
from qutebrowser.browser.webkit.network import networkreply

app = QApplication(sys.argv)

req = QNetworkRequest('http://example.com')
reply = networkreply.ErrorNetworkReply(req, "Error", QNetworkReply.NetworkError.HostNotFoundError)

error_received = {'value': False}
error_occurred_received = {'value': False}

def on_error(e):
    print(f"Received error signal: {e}")
    error_received['value'] = True

def on_error_occurred(e):
    print(f"Received errorOccurred signal: {e}")
    error_occurred_received['value'] = True

reply.error.connect(on_error)
reply.errorOccurred.connect(on_error_occurred)

QTimer.singleShot(100, app.quit)

sys.exit(app.exec_())

print("error received:", error_received['value'])
print("errorOccurred received:", error_occurred_received['value'])

if error_received['value'] and not error_occurred_received['value']:
    print("ERROR: Only deprecated error signal emitted")
    sys.exit(1)
elif not error_received['value'] and error_occurred_received['value']:
    print("FIXED: Only modern errorOccurred signal emitted")
    sys.exit(0)
else:
    print("Unexpected state")
    sys.exit(2)
EOF
